name: Something drifting
description: How a wreck arrives, and how to reach it.

pages.title: Something drifting
pages.text:
**Goal:** reach a Driftwreck before it unravels.\
Once your Clowder has tensioned Soil, pieces of the old world drift up to your pad now and then: roughly once every hour and a half of play, or sooner if you hang a **Driftlure** on your Tension Post.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
The Steward tells the whole Clowder when one is caught, and the **Drift Needle** points at it.\
Stand at your pad's edge, face the wreck and use a **Tether Spool**: a thread bridge lays itself across.

pages.title: It will not hold
pages.text:
A wreck only ages while someone in your Clowder is online.\
It creaks at half its time, starts to crumble at the rim near the end, and then unravels.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
Nobody falls: anyone on it is lifted home, and whatever you left in its chests comes home in a **Salvage Bundle** (in your **Salvage Crate**, if one stands by the Post).\
Fall off the tether and the thread catches you, for three hearts.

pages.title: What to do there
pages.text: Every wreck asks one thing: open its heart chest, break its frayed spawners, light its thread pillars in the order the idol shows, walk a lost Steward echo home, or hold the seam through three waves.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
Do it and each of you gets **Salvaged Weft** and a **Seal**, the **Wreck Atlas** fills a page, and sometimes a **Keepsake** comes home.\
**Check:** your Atlas shows the new page.

pages.title: Salvager's Frame
pages.text: Spend Weft on spools, lures, needles, map scrolls, Weft Keys, tribe decor and reprints of Keepsakes you already found.
